name: Are garage conversions allowed in all residential zones?

mainEntity.name: Are garage conversions allowed in all residential zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes in single-family zones with existing house; some areas restrict based on lot size (<7,000 sq ft may need parking review) or historic districts.
